# Fix m3: Strip footnote refs before striptags
with open('markdown/extensions/toc.py') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Find the run method and fix the name generation logic
old_name_logic = '''                    # Generate name using striptags (plain text without entity unescaping)
                    plain_text = striptags(processed_html)

                    # If data-toc-label exists, use it; otherwise use plain_text
                    if data_toc_label:
                        name_value = unescape(striptags(data_toc_label))
                    else:
                        name_value = plain_text

                    # Strip footnote references from name (R2)
                    name_value = re.sub(r'<sup[^>]*class="[^"]*footnote-ref[^"]*"[^>]*>.*?</sup>', '', name_value)'''

new_name_logic = '''                    # Strip footnote references from HTML first (before striptags)
                    processed_html_no_footnotes = re.sub(
                        r'<sup[^>]*class="[^"]*footnote-ref[^"]*"[^>]*>.*?</sup>',
                        '', processed_html
                    )

                    # Generate name using striptags (plain text without entity unescaping)
                    plain_text = striptags(processed_html_no_footnotes)

                    # If data-toc-label exists, use it; otherwise use plain_text
                    if data_toc_label:
                        name_value = unescape(striptags(data_toc_label))
                    else:
                        name_value = plain_text'''

content = content.replace(old_name_logic, new_name_logic)

with open('markdown/extensions/toc.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("m3 footnote fix written")
